description: Cyclist Flow Data - Quarterly is a dataset listed in Leicester Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Leicester City Council. This dataset shows the number of cyclists counted at various sites across the city. It provides a daily average per quarter. The data provided is a snapshot of particular points in the city and should not be used as a proxy for city wide levels of cyclists. Coverage: Leicester. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are cyclists, cycling. The portal shows 137 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-06-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-leicester-gov-uk-portal.
